title: Kidnapped
author: Robert Louis Stevenson
description: David Balfour’s stolen inheritance leads to flight and friendship in the Scottish Highlands.

longDescription: Movement, unfamiliar places and difficult choices carry the reading experience forward. Alongside the excitement, the story asks what loyalty, resourcefulness and courage look like under pressure. Its historical setting also reflects the assumptions of its period, which modern readers may wish to consider critically.

authorInfo.bio: Robert Louis Stevenson was a Scottish novelist, essayist, poet and travel writer. He is best known for the novels Treasure Island (1883), Strange Case of Dr Jekyll and Mr Hyde (1886), and Kidnapped (1886) and for the poetry collection A Child's Garden of Verses (1885).
